title: alnus fruticosa f. pubescens
intro: Alnus fruticosa f. pubescens, commonly known as pubescent alder, is a variety of alder tree native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It is a plant used in traditional medicine, valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of pubescent alder include its ability to modulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
